title: fix(scripts): the polarity census pins stop asserting what the live `.changeset/` holds, so the post-version tree validates (objectui#10010)
body:
Fixes #10010

Clause-②: no — root `scripts/` and a workflow step only; no published contract, accept set or public surface is touched

## What was red, and which control, measured

`changeset-release.yml`'s scheduled lane fails «Validate the post-version tree» on three pins in `scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` — «the default corpus is `.changeset/` and the script is not inside it», «runs from a clean checkout: no build, no workspace state, plain node» and «the REPORT prints the two named lines, and the merged heading is gone» — each `expected 2 to be +0`. The census header says exit 2 = a control failed. WHICH control was never measured on the card. It is now, on a post-version tree rendered locally the way the render step does it (`pnpm changeset:version` in a detached scratch worktree at `733fd5a`; never committed, never pushed; restored and removed afterwards):

| control (read at `733fd5a`) | normal tree | post-version tree |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `corpusLit` — present-tense declaration verb | 1369 — pass | **0 — FAIL** |
| `corpusAbsent` | 0 | 0 |
| `memberLit` — `BaseSchema.type` | 1 | 1 |
| `memberAbsent` | 0 | 0 |
| `resolutionLit` | 3 of 3 | 3 of 3 |
| `resolutionAbsent` | 0 | 0 |
| entries scanned | 2263 | 0 |

⇒ ONLY `corpusLit` goes dark. `changeset version` consumes every pending entry and leaves `.changeset/` holding its README and `config.json`, so the corpus is empty and the lit control reads 0. The census is RIGHT to exit 2 there: a corpus that holds nothing and a reader that read nothing are the same reading to it. The defect is in the three pins, which asserted exit 0 against the LIVE corpus — a fact about the tree's release phase, not about the instrument.

## When it started — the boundary, measured

The census and its test were born in `cec21a21ce` (objectui#9727, committed 2026-09-18T01:46:40Z): after the last green scheduled fire (00:20:11Z) and before the first red one (06:12:48Z). The two pin-7 exit-0 assertions are in that birth commit; the REPORT pin arrived later with objectui#9767. History was read on a shallow checkout whose graft is at 2026-05-23, with both legs: `git merge-base --is-ancestor fbe1520c13 cec21a21ce` answers 0; the census file is absent at the birth commit's parent (exit 128) while `package.json` is present there (exit 0).
⚠️ NOT explained here: the earlier red stretch (2026-09-12..09-16) predates the census file; not measured.

## The same defect was waiting on `main`

The rendered post-version tree is also what `main` holds right after the Version Packages PR merges, and `ci.yml` runs this suite there. So the old pins would have gone red on `main` after the next release too, and the `entriesScanned > 300` floor would have stayed red until 300 new entries accumulated. (Inference from the rendered tree; there has been no release merge since the census landed.) Editing only the workflow step would have left that standing; fixing the pins repairs both.

## What changed

- `scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts`
  - pin 7 «the default corpus is `.changeset/`…» still runs on the live default corpus, and now asserts only what holds in every release phase: the corpus directory is `.changeset/`; `entriesScanned` equals that directory's pending entries EXACTLY (replaces the `> 300` floor, and catches both a tree-wide scan and an empty reader); the exit status is the controls' verdict; every control that does not read the corpus's content passes; and the run is void only when the lit control reads 0.
  - pin 7 «runs from a clean checkout…» and pin 11 «the REPORT prints the two named lines…» assert exit 0 on the fixture corpus, over the live member index and the live resolution roots — they are about the instrument.
  - new pin 6 case: an EMPTY corpus exits 2, and the lit control is the one that goes dark while the other five pass. The control keeps its teeth, pinned without depending on the tree's release phase.
  - the failure messages carry the controls now. The old ones carried stderr, which the census leaves empty, so for ten days the lane's annotation said `expected 2 to be +0` and nothing about which control.
  - the file header's «every pin reads fixtures» paragraph is corrected to say which run reads the live corpus and why.
- `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`: header only — a new section «An EMPTY corpus exits 2, by construction». The control logic and the 0/1/2 exit contract are unchanged; ⛔ an empty corpus is NOT special-cased to exit 0.
- `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`: untouched.

## Evidence — red before, green after, on the same rendered tree

- Post-version tree, without the change: `pnpm test scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` gives `Tests 3 failed | 68 passed (71)` — the three pins above, each `expected 2 to be +0`, the lane's shape exactly.
- The same rendered tree with the two files checked out from `16169cca22`: `Tests 72 passed (72)`. The census itself still exits 2 there, `corpusLit` reading 0.
- Step 14 in full on that rendered tree (`pnpm quick-reference:check && pnpm check:control-bytes && pnpm test scripts/__tests__`): exit 0, `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5323 passed | 2 skipped (5325)`.
- Ablation — the relaxation the card forbids. The lit clause in `runControls` was mutated to pass on an empty corpus, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hits 1 to 0, blob `b66d877f` to `86b95436`): the new empty-corpus pin goes red, `1 failed | 71 passed (72)`, message «an empty corpus must NOT exit 0: expected +0 to be 2». Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Direction observed: red, as predicted.
- Scratch tree restore: the workflow's own restore, then `git status --porcelain` printed 0 lines; the worktree was then removed.

## Gates (normal tree, at `16169cca22`)

- `pnpm test scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` — `72 passed (72)`
- `pnpm test scripts/__tests__` — exit 0, `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5323 passed | 2 skipped (5325)`
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` — exit 0
- `pnpm quick-reference:check` — exit 0; `pnpm check:control-bytes` — exit 0, OK line
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` — `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`, exit 0
- `node scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs` — exit 0
- ESLint narrowed to the two changed files: `--format json` reports 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population per ESLint's own `--print-config`: the test file resolves 118 rules, the `.mjs` 0 rules; neither sets `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and `eslint.config.js` sets neither anywhere ⇒ no type-aware linting ⇒ this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — «no changeset is owed». ⇒ No changeset entry, per the census header's objectui#9795 rule: a change to this script gets no entry, not even an empty-frontmatter one. `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals` were therefore not run (no entry added).
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over both paths — NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui#10019, the ordering fact recorded on the card, is no longer open (state reason: completed, 2026-09-20) — the door it guarded is already shut.
- With the pins green, the scheduled lane's next fire should reach «Refresh the version PR» again. That is the lane's own act. This PR takes no release action and touches neither the Version Packages PR nor its branch.
- `eslint.config.js` resolves zero rules for this `.mjs` (read via `--print-config`). Observation only, not filed; carrier: none.
